title: Have you stayed at these beachside locations?
content: The large bungalow style housing always has tons of people staying there - like a vacation. All the rooms seem connected with a sliding paper wall in between. Very minimal inside and I find myself walking up the side walkway often. The smaller, summer camp-style cabins always feel good. They seemed to be packed to the gills with friends. I find myself going from cabin to cabin looking for a place to stay. It is dark and dank inside like a mix of a cabin during the day and a college dorm.
